title: Slide Plan
description: Per-page plan for an AI-generated slide deck. Authoritative source for Step 7 renderers (Web and Image).

narrative_arc.description: Hook-Context-Core-Shift-Takeaway or one of the named arcs from context_pack.md

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the primary language of on-slide text (e.g. zh-CN, en-US)

source_outline.description: Path to outline.md this plan was derived from

page_id.description: Zero-padded page id, e.g. P01, P02, ... P100

page_title.description: On-slide title text. May be empty for full-bleed image pages.

page_goal.description: What this page must achieve in the deck's story. NOT what it says — what it does.

key_message.description: The ONE sentence that, if the audience remembers only one thing from this page, they should remember.

body.description: Bullet points or short paragraphs to render on the slide. Density should follow style_lock.density.

speaker_notes.description: What the presenter says when this slide is up. Used by HTML renderer's <aside class=notes>.

visual_direction.description: Free-form visual description for this page. Image Renderer uses this + style_lock to derive the per-page prompt. For HTML, used by layout snippet choice + decorative element hints.

layout_type.description: Layout hint for the Web Renderer (model designs the page accordingly); not tied to any template file.

intent.description: Why an image is needed on this page (hero, illustration, diagram, photo evidence, decorative ...)

text_in_image_risk.description: Image models are unreliable with text rendering. high → consider HTML path for this page.

aspect_ratio_override.description: Per-page override of deck-level canvas_ratio. Rare; usually inherit.

generated_image_path.description: Optional rendered image path for HTML embedding. If empty or omitted, Web Renderer checks the delivery convention images/slide-NN.png.

page_rhythm.description: Optional rhythm tag borrowed from ppt-master. Helps Style Guard catch monotonous decks.

evidence_refs.description: References to entries in context_pack.md § Key Claims or § Knowledge Base. Used by Reviewer to verify factual claims.
